verdict.rationale: Cline's evidence covers a Kanban task board for running parallel agents with worktrees, MCP integrations, and skills/instructions, but none of this describes ingesting team docs and repos into a shared knowledge workspace or source-of-truth repository for engineering leads. Missing for 10: any feature for indexing/aggregating documentation and codebases into a shared, queryable team knowledge base, evidence of team-wide onboarding or knowledge-sharing workspace, and any first-party or community mention of such a capability.
